title: Holographic information measures for spin-$3/2$ $Δ$ baryons in AdS/QCD
summary: Spin-$3/2$ $Δ$ baryon resonances are investigated within AdS/QCD, using Rarita-Schwinger fields. The differential configurational entropy (DCE) and differential configurational complexity (DCC) associated with their bulk energy densities are computed. It yields Regge-like trajectories relating configurational information measures to the radial excitation number and the experimental mass spectrum of the $Δ$ baryons. We then extrapolate the spectrum of heavier $Δ$ baryon resonances beyond the currently established states in the PDG, also comparing them with states in the PDG that are omitted…
